title: Crew asks $5, $10 or $25 with $10 suggested, and the supporter mark follows active support for 45 days
detail: PHASE 4 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). PWYW_CONFIG_DEFAULT presets 499/1000/2500, suggested 1000, and the catalog.pwyw row in production (suggested 2499 today, a migration). earnsSupporterMark stops reading the suggested amount: any active Crew earns it, fading 45 days after support stops. Picker copy: one impact line, a dignified "not right now", "contribute what you want" (ADR-1084).

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const c=r("lib/pricing/catalog-config.ts");const d=(c.split("PWYW_CONFIG_DEFAULT: PwywConfig = {")[1]||"").split("}")[0];if(!/suggestedCents:\s*1000/.test(d))fail("suggested is not 1000");if(!/presetCents:\s*\[499,\s*1000,\s*2500\]/.test(d))fail("presets are not 499/1000/2500");if(/suggestedCents/.test((c.split("export function earnsSupporterMark")[1]||"").split("\n}")[0]))fail("the supporter mark still keys off the suggested amount");if(!/45/.test(c))fail("no 45-day fade");console.log("ok: Crew presets and the fading mark are in")'
